name: Hamish Te Kanawa
bio:
Hamish grew up around engines. His father owned a small garage in rural New Zealand, and Hamish spent his childhood covered in grease, learning the intricacies of internal combustion. While he enjoyed the hands-on work, he dreamed of applying his skills to something faster, something more competitive. He landed a spot with a local racing team, honing his skills on the NZ motorsport scene. 

His meticulous approach and ability to troubleshoot under pressure caught the eye of a Team Penske scout. He relocated to the US, and quickly established himself as a reliable and innovative machinist within the IndyCar program. Hamish believes in precision above all else, and his dedication to quality has earned him the respect of his peers. He strives for perfection, often working late into the night to ensure every component meets his exacting standards. 

While he's a highly skilled machinist, he prefers to work independently. Hamish is a perfectionist and sometimes struggles to delegate, leading to some late nights in the shop ensuring every part is up to his high standards.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly combed back, receding hairline
physical.description: Hamish is a solidly built man with a no-nonsense demeanor and strong hands.

quirks: Always has a small, well-worn copy of an engineering handbook in his pocket.
Sharpens his pencils with a pocketknife before starting any new project.
Listens to classic rock on his headphones while working, but only at low volume.
